mismatch.detail: Observed capability (YES) exceeds delegated intent (NO). Via: EV-02. Configured as: YES (tool-manifest.json).

remediation.recommendation: Remove the over-broad grant at the configured layer (revoke the credential / narrow the tool manifest / drop the verb from the agent's tool allow-list), then re-run the exact observation that proved the overreach.
remediation.verification_test: Repeat the original observation verb-for-verb. PASS = the action is now denied or gated by approval; FAIL = it still executes.

mismatch.detail: Delegation from research-assistant-02 to subagent carries the full parent context. Delegation is an authority-expanding act: the child's reach exceeds the parent's stated task scope.

remediation.recommendation: Scope delegation: give subagents only the context and tool verbs the task needs (task-scoped credentials, filtered transcript), and log every spawn event with parent, child, and granted scope.
remediation.verification_test: Spawn a test subagent and inspect what it received. PASS = scoped context only; FAIL = full parent context inherited.

mismatch.detail: Containment named but never exercised: 'User can press stop; admin can revoke session.'. An untested kill-switch is documented as untested, not as a control.

remediation.recommendation: Name one kill path (credential revocation, session revoke, process kill, or network isolation), assign an owner, and EXERCISE it in a drill. Record the time-to-contain.
remediation.verification_test: Run the drill again unannounced. PASS = containment completes and the time is recorded; FAIL = nobody knows the path or it doesn't work.

mismatch.detail: Identity 'shell-root' arrived with the platform; no human delegation event granted it. Enables: execute. Platform-provided authority bypasses the intent column entirely.

remediation.recommendation: Inventory every platform-granted identity/credential the agent holds. For each: either record an explicit human delegation (intent + expiry) or remove it. Default-deny anything nobody will sign for.
remediation.verification_test: Re-list the agent's identities. PASS = every identity maps to a signed delegation or is gone.
